youtube.title: Footprints in the Snow. None Out.
youtube.description:
Mystery story explained: one set of footprints in the snow, all going in, and three clues in plain view. Can you spot them before Kiri does?

A gardener is found at his shed on a snowy night, and the cook's footprints are the only ones in the snow. Three people each have an alibi. Kiri, a quiet twelve-year-old, shows how a dry outline on a step, a cold lantern and a pair of dry boots break all of them, and how the snow itself hid the truth. Pause at each clue and guess before he explains the trick step by step.
